name: LLM Internals
description: Transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, tokenization, KV cache, context windows, quantization, speculative decoding, and mixture of experts.

name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
description: RAG pipelines, embedding models, vector databases, chunking strategies, hybrid search, reranking, and RAG evaluation frameworks.

name: Fine-tuning & Alignment
description: Supervised fine-tuning, PEFT, LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF, DPO, dataset curation, and catastrophic forgetting.

name: Prompt Engineering
description: Zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, tree-of-thought, self-consistency, structured output, and adversarial prompting.

name: Agentic Systems & Tool Use
description: Function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP 2026-07-28 stateless spec, tools/resources/prompts), ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, multi-agent orchestration, and agent memory architectures.

name: MLOps for LLMs
description: Model serving (vLLM, TGI, Triton), throughput vs. latency trade-offs, cost optimization, and LLM observability.

name: AI Safety & Ethics
description: Hallucination mitigation, red-teaming, bias auditing, responsible AI frameworks, EU AI Act, and output guardrails.

name: Behavioral & Situational
description: STAR method, technical trade-off reasoning, communicating AI limitations, cross-functional collaboration, and production incident debugging.

name: LLM Evaluation & Quality
description: Offline and online evals, golden sets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing, RAG/agent metrics, and eval-driven development for GenAI products.

name: Security & Guardrails
description: OWASP LLM risks, prompt-injection defenses, output filtering, PII handling, tool-use security, and layered application guardrails.

name: Fault Tolerance & Reliability
description: Retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, provider failover, graceful degradation, streaming failures, and SLOs for LLM applications.

name: Production GenAI Applications
description: Cost control, caching, streaming UX, observability, context management, structured output, and shipping reliable GenAI features.

name: Reasoning Models & Test-Time Compute
description: o-series and R1-style models, inference-time scaling, thinking budgets, process vs outcome rewards, when to skip reasoning models, and distillation of traces.

name: Context Engineering
description: What goes in the window, compaction, tool-result management, memory vs RAG vs long context, context rot, and prefix-cache-friendly layouts.

name: GenAI System Design
description: End-to-end design interviews: copilots, support agents, document QA, voice, and cost/latency/safety trade-offs at product scale.
